system.description:
Usage worn.

The lens is made from cloudy translucent material traditionally claimed to be powdered bone fused into glass. Looking through it gives healthy flesh an unsettlingly anatomical appearance.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Examine the Dead and Perform Autopsy. When examining a corpse, you also gain a +2-status bonus to checks made to identify evidence of disease, poison, possession, magical transformation or supernatural interference with the body.

You also gain the Read Vital Traces ability:

Read Vital Traces:

Activate Interact (2 AP)

Frequency 1/day

The monocle reproduces the informational effects of Vital Diagnosis, except the target must be a creature or corpse you can physically examine through the lens. It does not grant the Healer trait or allow access to other Healer Specialist Spells.

On the sheet: +2 status is pre-ticked on Examine the Dead and Perform Autopsy and offered on other checks over a corpse; Read Vital Traces is Vital Diagnosis as an innate spell, 1/day.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
